integrity: The proof reduces every prime-power divisor block to a power of the target prime, forcing all nonspecial source primes to exponent one and to the form r+ell^j. The only repeatable source prime is ell=r+1. This yields the exact coefficient formulas. A separate bounded checker evaluates the arithmetic function from factorizations and compares observed and predicted fibers.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies only prime-power target fibers of Schemmel totients. It does not resolve multi-prime target fibers or Polignac's conjecture. The r=1 specialization is classical. A 1989 Yip thesis on Schemmel inverse-value problems was bibliographically identified but not available in complete public text, so equivalent coverage there remains a residual risk.
title: Exact prime-power fibers of Schemmel totients
